road.title: Advice
road.description: Someone of no particular height, which they regard as a professional asset in a coat with more pockets than the law requires, guarding a teapot with their life. Clementina is a Consulting Busybody and gives advice by the quarter-hour and refunds nothing if it is taken.

openObjectives.prompt: Clementina has a sign up offering advice and, so far today, no takers. Tell Clementina that you have a problem and do not know what to do, using Italian.

character.name: Clementina Hinge
character.description: Someone of no particular height, which they regard as a professional asset in a coat with more pockets than the law requires, guarding a teapot with their life. Clementina is a Consulting Busybody and gives advice by the quarter-hour and refunds nothing if it is taken.

npc.narrative: It is notte and the stelle are out over The Punctual Windfall, a small locanda with one candela lit and a vecchio gatto asleep on the tavolo. Clementina Hinge sits behind a stack of carte, each stamped with a quarter-hour. She waves you through the porta with a pen.
npc.native: Buonasera! Sono Clementina Hinge, e do consigli ogni quarto d'ora. Stasera ho un problema: ho dieci carte e non so cosa fare. Un amico dice: "Dovresti dormire", che buon consiglio! Che problema hai tu stasera, e cosa pensi del mio lavoro?
npc.translation: Good evening! I am Clementina Hinge, and I give advice every quarter of an hour. Tonight I have a problem: I have ten cards and I don't know what to do. A friend says: "You should sleep", what good advice! What problem do you have tonight, and what do you think of my work?

player: Buonasera Clementina. Sì, ho un problema: il mio vicino suona la tromba ogni notte e non so cosa fare. Non dormo da una settimana!

verdict.overallFeedback: Lovely answer! You told Clementina about your noisy neighbour and said you don't know what to do, all in clear Italian.

objectiveResults.feedback: Well done: you told Clementina you have a problem and don't know what to do.
You didn't tell Clementina what she should do yet; try giving her a bit of advice, and it will come up again later.
You didn't say that it is good advice yet; react to a piece of advice by calling it good, and it will come up again later.

openObjectives.prompt: Clementina has explained a difficulty at some length and has now stopped, expectantly. Tell Clementina what they should do, using Italian.
Tell Clementina that it is good advice, using Italian.

npc.narrative: The notte is molto calm, ma the stelle hang above the strada. Poi Clementina counts on her dita and frowns at her carte as if they owed her soldi. Beyond the collina, something brassy clears its throat.
npc.native: Una settimana senza dormire! Primo: dovresti parlare con il vicino; secondo: dovresti dormire di giorno, che è un buon consiglio. Io ho dieci carte e non so cosa fare: cosa dici tu, e come suona il tuo vicino?
npc.translation: A week without sleeping! First: you should talk to the neighbour; second: you should sleep during the day, which is good advice. I have ten cards and I don't know what to do: what do you say, and how does your neighbour play?

player: Suona molto male, purtroppo! Per le tue carte... secondo me dovresti giocare a solitario. E parlare con il vicino è un buon consiglio, grazie.

verdict.overallFeedback: Great job! You described your neighbour's trumpet, gave Clementina advice about her cards and thanked her for the good advice, all in correct Italian.

objectiveResults.feedback: Well done: you told Clementina what she should do with "dovresti giocare a solitario".
Well done: you called it good advice with "è un buon consiglio".

npc.narrative: Una bella notte: le stelle are out, and Clementina lays her carte on the tavolo like a woman who has won something. Lontano, una tromba clears its throat, piano, and nobody asks permission.
npc.native: Solitario! È un buon consiglio, grazie mille. Io dico: dovresti parlare con il vicino domani, e poi dovresti dormire. Cosa fai tu domani, e che cosa pensi del mio lavoro?
npc.translation: Solitaire! It is a good piece of advice, thank you very much. I say: you should talk to the neighbour tomorrow, and then you should sleep. What are you doing tomorrow, and what do you think of my job?

player: Domani lavoro, purtroppo, e sarò molto stanco. Il tuo lavoro mi sembra utile, ma perché nessuno viene stasera?

npc.narrative: The stelle are out over the strada, and the tavolo between you holds ten carte, one candela and a notebook of numbered advice. Clementina writes something in it, then looks up. Nobody else is there, except the notte.
npc.native: Domani lavori, che peccato! Primo: è notte e la gente dorme. Secondo: forse i problemi dormono con la gente. Chiedi pure del mio lavoro, ho molte idee! Che lavoro fai tu, e cosa fai stasera con la tromba del vicino?
npc.translation: You work tomorrow, what a pity! First: it is night and people are sleeping. Second: maybe problems sleep with the people. Do ask about my work, I have many ideas! What work do you do, and what do you do tonight with the neighbour's trumpet?

player: Faccio l'insegnante in una scuola. Stasera? Forse metto i tappi nelle orecchie. Se tu fossi me, cosa faresti?

npc.narrative: Clementina holds up tre dita and a small candela, which lights her quaderno and not much else. Above the strada the stelle are out, and very many. Somewhere beyond the colline, a tromba clears its throat.
npc.native: Insegnante! Che lavoro bello. Al tuo posto, io faccio tre cose: primo, metto i tappi nelle orecchie; secondo, parlo con il vicino; terzo, dormo. Che cosa insegni nella tua scuola, e cosa vuoi chiedere tu del mio lavoro?
npc.translation: A teacher! What a lovely job. In your place, I do three things: first, I put plugs in my ears; second, I talk to the neighbour; third, I sleep. What do you teach in your school, and what do you want to ask about my work?

player: Insegno storia ai bambini. Va bene, provo i tuoi tre consigli. Quanto costa un consiglio?

npc.narrative: Under the stelle of a quiet notte, Clementina opens a piccolo quaderno and hunts for her matita, which is behind her orecchio. The pagina is headed with a lista of prices, crossed out due volte, and beneath it a column of ultime parole that is one short.
npc.native: Storia, che bello! Primo: un consiglio costa una moneta ogni quarto d'ora. Secondo: se segui il consiglio, io non rimborso niente. Quale storia piace di più ai tuoi bambini, e cosa vuoi chiedere ancora del mio lavoro?
npc.translation: History, how lovely! First: a piece of advice costs one coin every quarter of an hour. Second: if you follow the advice, I refund nothing. Which story do your children like most, and what else do you want to ask about my work?
